reasoning: The icon clearly combines a stacked folder outline with a central cloud glyph, universally understood as cloud storage directories or synced folders (like Google Drive, Dropbox, or iCloud). It fits common digital housekeeping, backup, and file-sharing tasks well, though it sits alongside several similar folder and cloud variants.
